path_syntax: <file under docs/data/, glob allowed>:<dotted path>. 'name[]' steps into every item of a list, '*' into every value of an object. A field is present when at least one file gives it a value that is not null, empty text, an empty list or an empty object.

grid.spec_row: Grid, states, compare modes, expand/collapse, sections

abbreviations.spec_row: Abbreviations (display-only label map in web/, keyed by canonical_account_id)

budget_class.spec_row: Account type filter, "incl. mandatory" tags, "Appropriated mandatory" sub-group

nondefense.spec_row: Defense / nondefense column: the nondefense figure

account_page.spec_row: Account page (the One account view): header, enacted history, every stage every year, related

find_changes.spec_row: Find changes: preset questions, condition builder, results (differences between two printed figures only)

find_moves.spec_row: Find changes: Moves and reorganizations (from relationships)

whats_new.spec_row: What's new: source documents by the date each was added to the record (built at export time; no alerts or email)
whats_new.waits_for: Off until D-5 publishes a first-added date per source document and an added date per figure (field names as D-5 sets them; update these paths then). retrieval_timestamp is not used: it changes on every re-fetch or reparse (owner, 2026-10-14). The page code and data/whats_new.json stay; the page reads documents[].retrieved today and moves to the first-added date with D-5.

watchlist.spec_row: Watch (browser storage only; no alerts or email)

basis_adjustments.spec_row: Amount basis: the adjustments from As printed to the view

shapes.rows[].cells.<FY|stage>.views.<basis>: a list: [{amount, timing: available|enacted (null for printed), status: checked|computed|excluded|not_computable, reason, printed_observation_id?, validation_id?, component_ids?, accounts_behind?, adjustments?}]. One entry for timing 'available' and, only where it differs, one for 'enacted': with no 'enacted' entry the 'available' one holds for both timings. basis: printed, discretionary, discretionary_designated, all_appropriations, program_level (accounting.BASES). Only on cells whose headline holds a value; amount is null unless status is checked or computed.
shapes.rows[].cells.<FY|stage>.components[]: {component_id, type, amount, in_headline, within_component_id, designation, transfer_from, source_document_id, source_page, source_table_or_section}
shapes.rows[].cells.<FY|stage>.earmark: {amount, component_ids[]}; only where earmark components are tagged (absent is not zero)
shapes.rows[].cells.<FY|stage>.defense_portion: {amount, component_ids[]}; only where defense_portion components are tagged (absent is not zero)
shapes.rows[].attributes.<FY>: {budget_class, provisional, budget_subfunction, fund_type, account_id_code, stage_basis, source_document_id, source_page, citations: {<attribute>: {account_attribute_id, source_document_id, source_page}}, request?: {the same, stage_basis 'request', where the President's Budget has its own value}}; an attribute with no record is absent
shapes.split: index.json split_subcommittees lists the subcommittees also published per fiscal year: subcommittees/<SC>/index.json (everything but rows, titles, bill_total; files: {FY: file}) and subcommittees/<SC>/<FY>.json (rows, titles, bill_total with that year's cells and attributes only). subcommittees/<SC>.json stays the whole grid.
shapes.rows[].cells.<FY|stage>.views_excluding_: the shape of views.<basis>, every basis including printed: that view less the earmark components inside the headline (accounting.excluded_amount; ACCOUNTING_RULES 'excluding earmarks'). Only on cells that have views. An account outside the auto-tagged cells (tag_components.coverage()) is not_computable, reason 'earmarks not tagged for this stage', except a President's Budget cell: a request carries no earmarks, so every entry equals its views entry (D-6 structural rule; an excluded or not computable view stays so). An account's entry is computed (never checked). A total's entry (D-6) is the sum of its lines' entries: checked where its views.<basis> entry is checked and no line has an earmark tagged; computed 'sum of N accounts; ...'; not_computable naming a line that is, or where its lines as printed don't add up to the printed total. Every total entry carries accounts_behind.
shapes.rows[].cells.<FY|stage>.views_nondefense: as views_excluding_earmarks, for defense_portion components (ACCOUNTING_RULES 'nondefense'); untagged reason 'defense not tagged for this stage', except an account whose subfunction (FY N's own Appendix volume) is not 05x (and not 999), with no defense line printed and no defense_portion tagged: every entry equals its views entry, reason 'not a defense function (subfunction NNN)' (D-6 structural rule). A defense_portion printed beside the headline (NSF) is not in it, so takes nothing out.
D-6: on every entry with an amount (views and both exclusion fields), what turns the As printed figure into it; As printed + the adjustments (sign +/-) = amount, exactly. An account's: [{component_id, type, label, sign, amount, source_document_id, source_page, source_location}], one per component the view takes out (-) or adds (+). A total's: [{type, label, sign, amount, accounts: [{canonical_account_id, amount, components}]}] grouped by component type and sign; type left_out_by_basis: the accounts the basis leaves out (their As printed figure); type held_line_not_counted: lines the table prints inside the total, held beside an account's headline, that the basis doesn't count separately ({lines: [{account, observation_id, label, amount, source_document_id, source_page, why}]}); type printed_total: a printed parallel total measure_reconcile matched, where the lines are not summed. Empty when the entry equals As printed (unless two adjustments offset).
